title: MemoryUpdate
description: Result of an authorized memory transaction (persist/forget/seal/etc.) for a pipeline run. See /artifacts/memory-update.md.

result.description: Transaction outcome. Must be explicit; partial forgets must never be reported as succeeded.

memory_ids.description: Identifiers of the memory records affected by this operation. Opaque handles into the memory subsystem.

retention_policy_id.description: Identifier of the governed retention policy applied to this transaction.

source_refs.description: Upstream artifacts this memory transaction is grounded in (typically sealed Knowledge and EmbeddingJob).

denial_reason.description: Required when result=denied; explains exactly why the transaction did not proceed.

incomplete_forget_ids.description: Populated when a forget operation could not fully complete; names the specific memory_ids still outstanding.
